<?php
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';

// Suppress the usage-data consent modal
update_option( 'sm_user_consent', 'no' );
// Hide beta & auto-update banners for clean demo
update_option( 'sm_show_beta_banner', 'false' );
if ( ! get_option( 'sm_beta_banner_discarded_on' ) ) {
    update_option( 'sm_beta_banner_discarded_on', gmdate( 'Y/m/d' ) );
}
update_option( 'sm_beta_banner_discarded_count', 2 );
update_option( 'sm_hide_auto_update_banner', 'yes' );

// Seed demo content to verify sitemap generation
$cat = wp_insert_term( 'Sitemap Demo Category', 'category' );
$tag = wp_insert_term( 'Sitemap Demo Tag', 'post_tag' );
$post_id = wp_insert_post( array(
    'post_title'   => 'Post included in XML sitemap',
    'post_content' => 'This post was created by the Playground blueprint to populate the sitemap.',
    'post_status'  => 'publish',
    'post_category'=> array( is_wp_error($cat) ? get_cat_ID('Sitemap Demo Category') : $cat['term_id'] ),
    'tags_input'   => array( 'Sitemap Demo Tag' )
) );

// Configure plugin options to show HTML sitemap, include categories & tags
$opts = (array) get_option( 'sm_options', array() );
$opts['sm_b_html']   = true;
$opts['sm_in_cats']  = true;
$opts['sm_in_tags']  = true;
update_option( 'sm_options', $opts );
?>
